title: trends and themes of cash waqf in islamic finance’s research: a bibliometric analysis
core_idea: To chart the development and thematic contours of cash waqf research within Islamic finance by applying an integrated bibliometric/scientometric approach to publications indexed in Scopus and Web of Science, analyzed with Scientopy and VOSviewer.
tldr: A bibliometric study designed to map the development and themes of cash waqf research in Islamic finance using Scopus and Web of Science records and scientometric tools.
